paye.source: Income Tax Act s.37 (PAYE), s.30 (personal relief) and Third Schedule, as amended by the Finance Act 2023 (bands from 1 July 2023)

nssf.source: NSSF Act 2013 s.20 Year 4, from February 2026 (lower limit KES 9,000, upper KES 108,000; 6% each from employee and employer)

shif.source: Social Health Insurance Act 2023 and Social Health Insurance (General) Regulations 2024 (2.75% of gross, at least KES 300, from 1 October 2024); deductible before PAYE from 27 December 2024 (Tax Laws (Amendment) Act 2024)

ahl.source: Affordable Housing Act 2024 s.4 (1.5% of gross from employee and employer); deductible before PAYE from 27 December 2024, replacing the 15% housing relief (Tax Laws (Amendment) Act 2024)

nita.source: Industrial Training (Training Levy) Order 2007: KES 50 per employee per month, paid by the employer

deductions.source: Income Tax Act s.22A and s.15(3)(b) and s.22D, as amended by the Tax Laws (Amendment) Act 2024 (from 27 December 2024)

reliefs.source: Income Tax Act s.31 (15% of qualifying premiums, at most KES 5,000 a month)

benefits.source: Income Tax Act s.5(4)(a), as amended by the Tax Laws (Amendment) Act 2024: non-cash benefits worth KES 5,000 a month or less in total are not taxed; above that, all of it is
